svg.title: MyoWare 2.0 Wireless Shield connection map
svg.desc: Logical connection map, not a PCB layout. The stacked sensor and shield connect 3.3 volt regulated VIN and ground. RAW connects to GPIO36. Envelope GPIO39 and reference monitor GPIO35 are not used. Use battery only while body-connected and detach the shield before USB charging or flashing.

g.text: A clear path to your first wireless channel.
Logical connection map for the MyoWare 2.0 Wireless Shield. Pin positions here are schematic, not physical.
ENV → GPIO39: connected by shield, unused by this firmware.
REF monitor → GPIO35: unused; not an electrode wiring point.
Remove the Wireless Shield from the muscle sensor before USB programming or charging. Never wire electrodes directly to an ADC.
Bench-test first. Confirm board revision, stack alignment and supply rails against the manufacturer documentation before powering on.
NO CUSTOM PCB IS IMPLIED · THIS DRAWING DOES NOT REPLACE THE MANUFACTURER'S ASSEMBLY GUIDE
